data.one_liner: Wrapper plugin to insert Google AdSense snippets in Flutter Web apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to initialize AdSense and display H5 Games Ads or Ad Unit widgets on web. Includes a testing callback for deterministic unit tests.
use_when: You need Google AdSense ads in a Flutter Web project.
You are building a web‑based game and have beta approval for H5 Games Ads.
avoid_when: You lack the required AdSense beta approval.
strengths: Supports H5 Games Ads beta feature.
Provides a testing callback for unit tests.
weaknesses: Only works on web; no mobile support.
Requires beta approval; otherwise may violate policies.
Ad Unit widget is experimental and invitation‑only.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: For AdMob/AdSense ads on iOS and Android instead of web‑only support.
